title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 6 — WORLD 7: B2 CORE COMMUNICATION

targets.vocabulary: 1800+ active vocabulary, collocations, phrasal verbs, idiomatic language, academic and functional expressions
targets.listening: 12–14 minutes with natural multi-speaker and authentic-style input
targets.speaking: 15–18 minute sustained discussion, debate and interaction

grammar: reported speech and advanced reporting verbs
advanced relative clauses and sentence compression
complex noun phrases and academic style

missions.title: B2 Vocabulary & Collocation Lab
missions.focus: Expand precise B2 vocabulary through collocations, phrasal verbs, idioms and word families.

missions.title: Advanced Tense & Aspect Control
missions.focus: Choose advanced tense and aspect forms to express sequence, duration, completion and narrative perspective.

missions.title: Modals, Deduction & Nuance
missions.focus: Use modal structures to express certainty, probability, criticism, obligation, speculation and past deduction.

missions.title: Conditionals & Hypothetical Reasoning
missions.focus: Handle third, mixed and extended conditional structures while explaining consequences and alternative outcomes.

missions.title: Passive & Reporting Mastery
missions.focus: Transform information using passive reporting structures, reporting verbs and formal information patterns.

missions.title: Advanced Relative Clauses & Compression
missions.focus: Combine ideas efficiently with defining and non-defining relative clauses and reduced structures.

missions.title: Participle Clauses & Complex Sentences
missions.focus: Use participle clauses and complex sentence patterns to create concise, sophisticated communication.

missions.title: Emphasis, Inversion & Focus
missions.focus: Use inversion, cleft sentences and focus structures to highlight important information naturally.

missions.title: Cohesion, Coherence & Discourse Markers
missions.focus: Build longer spoken and written texts with clear logical links, referencing, sequencing and contrast.

missions.title: B2 Debate & Discussion Lab
missions.focus: Present a position, justify claims, challenge ideas, ask follow-up questions and respond to counterarguments.

missions.title: Reading Mastery — Argument & Author Purpose
missions.focus: Identify arguments, evidence, assumptions, tone, author purpose and implied meaning in extended texts.

missions.title: Listening Mastery — Multiple Perspectives
missions.focus: Follow natural conversations and discussions involving different speakers, attitudes, opinions and implied meanings.

missions.title: B2 Writing — Argumentative Essay
missions.focus: Write a structured 350–450 word argument with a clear position, developed reasons, examples, counterargument and conclusion.

missions.title: Formal Proposal & Report Writing
missions.focus: Produce organized formal proposals and reports using appropriate register, headings, evidence and recommendations.

missions.title: Presentation Mastery — Explain, Compare, Persuade
missions.focus: Deliver an 8–10 minute presentation that explains information, compares options and persuades an audience.

missions.title: Media, Technology & Society Simulation
missions.focus: Discuss digital life, media influence, technology choices and social change using evidence and nuanced language.

missions.title: Work, Study & Professional Communication
missions.focus: Handle meetings, academic discussion, workplace communication, requests, feedback and professional problem solving.

missions.title: Negotiation & Conflict Resolution
missions.focus: Clarify needs, propose compromises, disagree respectfully, negotiate solutions and resolve communication problems.

missions.title: B2 Integrated Skills Marathon
missions.focus: Complete a connected reading, listening, speaking and writing challenge built around one complex real-world scenario.

missions.title: WORLD 7 MASTER QUEST — B2 CORE COMMUNICATION
missions.focus: Complete a final B2 communication mission combining advanced grammar, vocabulary, comprehension, argumentation, presentation and real-world interaction.

assessment: comprehension of main ideas, details, inference and attitude
ability to justify opinions and respond to counterarguments
